name: Mojo
note: Pythonic compiled language aimed at systems and AI/GPU performance, with CPython interoperability
typeSystem: Statically typed, with type inference, structs, traits, value semantics, and ownership-aware lifetimes. Dynamic Python values are accessed explicitly through PythonObject when using CPython interoperability; ordinary Mojo code is not dynamically typed Python.
runtime: The mojo command JIT-compiles programs for immediate execution, while mojo build produces native executables. Mojo can call Python modules through an unmodified CPython runtime, which remains an external runtime dependency rather than a fallback executor for Mojo code.

runtimes.name: Native (MLIR/LLVM)
runtimes.role: JIT- or ahead-of-time compiles statically typed Mojo to native code; the toolchain also supports accelerator programming.

runtimes.name: CPython interoperability dependency
runtimes.role: Loads CPython as a dynamic library when Mojo code imports Python modules; this interpreter executes imported Python code, not Mojo code.

compilers.name: mojo build
compilers.role: Modular's compiler, built on the MLIR compiler infrastructure.

concurrencyModel: Provides explicit parallel constructs for numerical and AI workloads, including SIMD operations and GPU kernels. General-purpose tasking and concurrency facilities continue to evolve with the experimental language.
